meshy_tasks.prompt: Aeriex, the wind serpent creature for a stylised 3D creature-collecting action RPG, the SAME character, same body shape, same pose and same proportions as the grey-background 3D model render, repainted to match the board reference. BODY: the long serpentine neck, body and underside are a warm CREAM (#F3E6C8) with soft overlapping cream scale detail, never stark white. FEATHERS: the head crest, wing feathers and tail feathers are layered long feathers shading from deep teal (#2a8c8c) at the base through ocean blue (#3a86c0) and sky blue to bright ORANGE tips (#f08a3c) with a little golden yellow (#e8b048) between blue and orange; clear individual feather shapes with soft gradients. HEAD: a sharp ORANGE beak (#f0903a), cream face, and a large AMBER eye (#e09a2a iris) with a dark pupil and a white catchlight, clearly readable. Stylised hand-painted creature-game look with clean readable colour blocks, Palworld / Pokemon Legends style 3D render, not photoreal. Full body in frame, plain flat light grey background, even studio lighting, no clouds, no scenery, no text. No red, pink, maroon or oxblood anywhere. Single creature only.

review: Blender EEVEE turntable before/after and a head zoom inspected by the worker: cream scaled body, teal-to-orange feathers, orange beak and amber eye read. The red clamp moved 2,999 deep-orange texels to hue 28 (strict red 0.086% -> 0.015%).
